written_before: any held-out prediction was produced; the eval processes were on part0 with no output file yet

verdict_item_set.definition: the frozen held-out, all rows, the same basis as the canonical gate
verdict_item_set.abstention_excluded_variant: secondary diagnostic only, never the verdict

metric: chance-corrected accuracy (cc) by type; the noul column is the test, the aggregate is diluted by choice and score

resolution.basis: paired_power.detectable_delta(n, discordance=0.324, power=0.80); the 0.324 is the JevBench planning discordance and will be recomputed at the realized value as a statement beside the result, never as a revised bar

prediction.direction: noul cc rises; choice and score may move slightly down as the adapter spends capacity on a third task; a meaningful fall in both is a trade, not a win
prediction.flag: seed1's noul head is effectively off; if it does little, the 3/3-positive rule fails on the noul column regardless of seeds 0 and 2. No rerun and no tuning.

eval_identity.command:
cd /noul-arm && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= PYTHONPATH=/noul-arm python -m model.scripts.eval_listwise --checkpoint fullarm_noul/seed/listwise.pt --items /canonical/heldout_6400_part

.jsonl --base-probs /canonical/precompute-243366/base_probs_canonical_243366_qwen35_4b.jsonl --output fullarm_noul/seed/heldout_part

.pred.jsonl --device cuda

primary_comparison: noul cc on the 2,995-row column, noul arm minus canonical arm, per seed and pooled; resolution 3.0 pp, a smaller movement is 'did not resolve'
